name: generate_contextual_response
description: Generate a structured contextual response for RFQ collection conversations

acknowledgment.description: Acknowledge what the user provided in their message. Be specific about what information was captured.

progress_update.description: Provide a helpful update about the information collection process. Avoid showing completion percentages.

next_question.description: Ask for the most important missing information. Use the questions provided from the data model. Keep it conversational and clear.
